summary.en: Run the project's own linters and type checkers (ruff, mypy, tsc, eslint, go vet, cargo check) and get findings as file, line, code and message.
summary.ru: Запустить линтеры и проверки типов проекта (ruff, mypy, tsc, eslint, go vet, cargo check) и получить замечания как файл, строка, код и сообщение.

required.name: files.read
required.reason: to find which checkers the project configures

required.name: processes.run
required.reason: to run the checkers in the workspace sandbox

required.name: artifacts
required.reason: to keep the full checker output as a file

tools.name: run
tools.summary: Run the checkers the project configures (or the one named) and return findings per tool: file, line, column, code, severity, message, plus the exact command and a link to the full output.

tool.description: Defaults to auto: every checker the project's configuration names.

target.description: A file or folder to check; empty checks the whole project. tsc and cargo_check always check the whole project.
